messages:
maria: Heads up — saw another org's quota numbers in the console after a fast workspace switch :eyes:

maria: Repro steps: 1) open Org A dashboard 2) cmd+k -> Org B 3) open Usage panel. It shows A's numbers about 40% of the time when done quickly.

jordan: Interesting. Is this only on pages that use prefetch? Could be the prefetch cache key missing org id.

lee: Our prefetch flow calls /internal/prefetch?path=/tenant/usage and caches by url + query only. We don't include X-Org or route param currently.

alex: Can you paste a header capture + response body if you have one?

maria: Got one quick capture:
Request: GET /internal/prefetch?path=/tenant/usage
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
         X-User-Id: u_123
         X-Org-Id: org_987
Response body snippet: {"orgId":"org_987","usage":{...}}
But when UI renders for org_654 it shows the usage from org_987. Renderer seems to accept prefetch payload without validating org.

jordan: That explains it — prefetch cached the response for the URL and returned it to a different workspace. Two obvious fixes: (A) include org id in cache key, (B) validate response.orgId === requested org before using.

lee: Agreed. Also need to consider CDN/edge caching if we ever push prefetch to edge. For now in-app cache change is fastest.

alex: We should also add a server-side assert so bad payloads never get cached globally: if resp.orgId != req.header.X-Org-Id -> drop and return 412. Also instrument a metric prefetch.org_mismatch.

maria: I'll add an integration test that rapidly switches orgs and hits the prefetch path to catch regressions.

jordan: I'll own the telemetry and dashboard tile. Add a small canary rollout plan: 10% for 1h, 50% next 2h, full after metrics look clean.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: started canary for console-prefetch-orgkey @ 1752023499 :rocket:

lee: One more note — quota UI caches are TTL 30s and keyed by URL. Make sure quota keys are namespaced by org too, otherwise same class of bug will persist.

alex: Created PR D1234: https://git/repo/pull/1234 — adds org to prefetch cache key, server assert, telemetry, and e2e. Tests included.

maria: Nice. After canary I'd like to run a stress script that does switch+open in a tight loop for 5k iterations.

jordan: I'll add alerting: if prefetch.org_mismatch > 0.05% per minute we page.

maria: :thumbsup: Thanks y'all, will follow up with test results and screenshots.
